capabilities: connect one vault folder as the content root of a Nekote Blog site
publish notes and their referenced assets with a single command
convert Obsidian-flavored syntax (wikilinks, embeds, callouts, highlights) to standard Markdown
publish a single note and its assets without touching other posts
switch notes between published and draft via a frontmatter property
extras: Extensive privacy and network disclosures: uploads only notes under posts/ and pages/, never writes to the vault except for optional frontmatter template and image import actions, no telemetry; pricing details at nekote.blog/pricing.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Publish only targets Obsidian's own service, so publishing to an external blog requires a separate tool.

relations.evidence: Publish notes and their referenced assets from your vault to a Nekote Blog site.

requires.name: browser for device approval at dash.nekote.blog

summary: Publishing tool that sends notes and their referenced assets from a chosen vault folder to a Nekote Blog site, converting Obsidian syntax to standard Markdown.
